verdict.rationale: The evidence documents several separate connectivity products: verification, owner identification, balances, aggregation and extended history. Each is described as its own way to 'connect to an end user's financial institution'. The overview says the Connect Widget and Platform API let users connect, but nothing states that one connection or member serves several products at once without repeating the flow. A shared widget is an adjacent feature, not documented single-session reuse across products.

support.subject: As a developer, one link session can power multiple data products — auth, balances, transactions, identity — without forcing the user through separate connection flows per product
